description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw cards equal to half your library size and lose half your life total, rounding up both times.
Activate Skirge Familar by discarding any card besides Exsanguinate, adding {B}.
Repeat step 2 for all applicable cards in your hand.
Cast Exsanguinate by paying all available black mana, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amound of mana paid minus two, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
